*   **Precision Door (https://www.precisiondoor.net/locations/florida/south-florida/palm-beach-gardens):** Offers expert garage door repair services using premium parts in Palm Beach Gardens.
*   **Broten (https://www.broten.com/about/service-areas/palm-beach-gardens/):** Specializes in garage door sales and service since 1955, boasting a high customer satisfaction rating.
*   **Yelp Listings (https://www.yelp.com/search?cflt=garage_door_services&find_loc=Palm+Beach+Gardens%2C+FL):** Provides a compilation of top rated services and local contacts, such as Pine Air Fences & Doors and The Garagers.
*   **Meta Garage Doors (https://www.metagaragedoors.com/Meta-Garage-Door-Repair-Palm-Beach-Gardens-FL.html):** Offers comprehensive services including repair, installation, opener service, spring repair, and gate repair (Call: (561) 532-2990).
*   **Precision Garage Door (https://flgaragedoor.com/reviews/city/palm-beach-gardens):** Highly rated (4.98 Stars) for garage door repair, openers, and new installations.
*   **The Garage Door King (http://www.thegaragedoorking.org/):** Provides reliable, free advice and help for garage door repairs and springs (Call: (866) 807-6956 or (561) 662-2177).
*   **EDL GM (https://www.edl-gm.com/contact/florida-locations/palm-beach-gardens/):** Offers a selection of quality garage doors and entrance gate service for residential and commercial clients.
*   **Mr. Fix It Doors (https://mrfixitdoors.com/palm-beach-gardens/):** A genuine, family-owned company with 30 years of experience in the garage door repair industry.
